o: A tato myšlenka dojala jej tak, že poklekl a znovu se pomodlil, aby poděkoval Bohu za svoje uzdravení.
t: And this thought moved him so deeply that he knelt down and prayed again, to thank God for his recovery.

o: A opravdu byl více nežli napolo přesvědčen, že jeho první modlitba a velké uklidnění mysli, které mu přinesla, působily k jeho uzdravení více nežli ostatní jeho léčení.
t: And indeed he was more than half convinced that his first prayer and the great calm of mind it brought him had contributed more to his healing than all his other treatment.

o: – Od té doby si umínil, že bude častěji čist v bibli a přemýšlet o ní.
t: – From then on he resolved to read the Bible more often and to reflect on it.

o: Doposud znal tuto knihu skoro jen podle jména.
t: Until then he had known this book scarcely by name alone.

o: 4. července cítil se dosti silným, aby se opět vydal k vraku.
t: On July 4 he felt strong enough to set out for the wreck again.

o: Nalezl z něho jenom trochu prken a břeven na okraji přílivového dosahu.
t: He found only a few planks and beams from it at the edge of the reach of the tide.

o: Ale nechal je tam – po chvilce procházky cítil dosud přílišnou slabost a nechuť k pohybu.
t: But he left them there – after a short walk he still felt too weak and had no inclination to move.

o: Snad to bylo po jeho tabáku.
t: Perhaps it was his tobacco.

o: Věřil sice, že ho zbavil horečky, ale také, že jím byl na dlouho otráven.
t: He did believe that it had rid him of the fever, but also that he had been poisoned by it for a long time.

o: Pociťoval třesení a škubání nervů.
t: He felt trembling and a tugging of the nerves.

o: A tak pojal úmysl neomezovat se tolik jako dosud na pouhou práci s tím, co má jako pozůstatek ze zemí civilizace, ale rozhlédnout se důkladněji po ostrově, aby zjistil, co může získat zde, kde mu je usouzeno dále žít.
t: And so he formed the resolve not to limit himself, as he had until now, to mere work with what he had as a legacy from the lands of civilization, but to look about the island more thoroughly, to find out what he might gain here, where it was his fate to live on.

o: Nedostatek všech osvěžujících prostředků za jeho nemoci ho upozornil, jak velikou pošetilostí bylo, že se dosud vůbec nepokusil poznat zdejší ovoce a plodiny.
t: The lack of all refreshing remedies during his illness made him realize how great a folly it had been that he had not so much as tried to become acquainted with the local fruits and plants.

o: A ostatně jeho zásoby lodních potravin nebyly příliš veliké.
t: And besides, his stock of ship provisions was not very large.

o: Cukru a sucharů měl sice ještě dosti, ale ostatní bylo na sklonku, a čekat, až mu obilí vynese postačitelnou žeň, nemohl.
t: He still had a fair amount of sugar and ship's biscuit, but everything else was running low, and he could not wait for his grain to yield him a sufficient harvest.
